name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Incline Bench Press
steps: Set the bench to a moderate incline and lean back with your feet flat and one dumbbell above your shoulder.
Brace your core and keep your free hand at your hip or resting lightly at your side to maintain square shoulders.
Lower the dumbbell with control toward the outer upper chest with your elbow angled roughly 45 degrees from your torso.
Press the dumbbell straight back up to lockout, and switch sides once you finish one arm.
tips: Keep your upper back and hips pressed into the bench instead of twisting toward the working arm.
Avoid flaring your elbow directly out to the side as you lower the weight.
